info: Create OpenSpace visual regression test files by selecting a sequence of commands. The resulting .ostest file can be run by the OpenSpace test framework to verify that the application renders correctly.

downloaded.title: Test downloaded
downloaded.message: Your browser does not support choosing a save location, so {{name}} was sent to your downloads instead.

load-error.title: Failed to load test file "{{name}}"
load-error.invalid-file: The file is not a valid test file

navigationstate.label: Navigation State
navigationstate.description: Stores the current camera position (and optionally the time). Restores it when the test is run.

asset.label: Asset
asset.description: Causes the test to load a specific asset file.

property.label: Property
property.description: Stores a property value. When run, the property will be set to the stored value.

wait.label: Wait
wait.description: Causes the test to wait for a specified number of seconds before proceeding.

script.label: Script
script.description: A Lua script that will be executed during the regression test.

time.label: Time
time.description: Stores the in-game time and restores it when the test is run.

deltatime.label: Delta Time
deltatime.description: Sets the simulation delta time when the test is run.

property.value-description: Enter true/false for booleans, a number, or a string value.

navigation-state.fetch: Fetch current camera state from OpenSpace
